On Tue, 07 Dec 2026 at 09:02, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — attaching the Dec KPI packet (Dec_2026_Monthly_KPI_Dashboard.xlsx). High level asks:

Quick update: I'm digging into the Dec 4 P95 spike. Preliminary notes attached (autoscaler_incident_notes.pdf). TL;DR:

- Root cause appears to be a delayed scale-up path on one of the dedicated pools tied to the new scheduler heuristic (edge case when pre-warm is cold + short bursts).
- KV cache miss rate increased concurrently for the affected workloads (see appendix).
- Impact window ~ 02:05–02:18 UTC, P95 up by ~180ms on 16k token workloads.

Immediate mitigation: rolling disable of the new heuristic for the affected pools; longer fix will be a scheduler patch + a more conservative pre-warm policy. I'll aim to have the mitigation deployed by Wed morning and a short RCA note by Wed EOD.

Markus
